command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$nodes=@('SZ_Core','SZ_AR','PE3','PE2','PE1','BJHQ_CSR1000V_GW_01','Core_SW_01','Core_SW_02'); foreach(`$n in `$nodes){ `$outs=@{}; foreach(`$p in @('CampusNetwork-for-perf','CampusNetwork_05')){ `$o=''; foreach(`$c in @('display current-configuration','show running-config')){ `$u='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/'+`$p+'/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+[uri]::EscapeDataString(`$c); `$x=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u -Method Get).output; if(`$x -notlike 'Error:*'){ `$o=`$x; break } }; `$outs[`$p]=`$o }; `$a=`$outs['CampusNetwork-for-perf'] -split '\r?\n' | Where-Object { `$_ -notmatch '^(!Time:|!Last configuration)' }; `$b=`$outs['CampusNetwork_05'] -split '\r?\n' | Where-Object { `$_ -notmatch '^(!Time:|!Last configuration)' }; `$d=Compare-Object `$a `$b; '===== '+`$n+' diff='+@(`$d).Count+' ====='; `$d | Select-Object -First 80 | ForEach-Object { `$_.SideIndicator+' '+`$_.InputObject } }"
